statements: Offset paging loses and repeats orders while new ones arrive. Add listOrdersPage(store, { limit, cursor }) to src/orders.mjs, returning { items, nextCursor }.
Walking the pages from the start must give every order that existed at the start exactly once, whatever is added meanwhile. nextCursor is null on the last page.
The rules for limits and bad parameters are the ones the README gives for lists. A cursor that this service did not issue is a bad parameter with code invalid_cursor.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add cursor paging to the orders list, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
